tools.name: pushwing_show_connected_accounts

theme.description: Account widget theme; follows the host when omitted

tools.title: Show connected accounts
tools.description: Use this only when the user asks to see their connected accounts or account setup. Opens the connected-account widget with status, permissions and a management link. For account lookup during publishing, scheduling or reporting, use pushwing_list_connections instead; it returns the same account data without opening a widget. The optional theme changes the widget only.

tools.name: pushwing_show_usage_limits

connection_id.description: Optional owned account from list_connections; personal allowances remain user-wide

tools.title: Show usage and limits
tools.description: Use this only when the user asks to see their usage, allowances or limits. Opens the usage widget with the same personal allowances, reservations, budgets and availability as pushwing_get_usage_limits. An optional owned connection_id includes account context and Instagram capacity. For routine checks during publishing or scheduling, use pushwing_get_usage_limits instead; it returns data without opening a widget. This reading reserves no capacity.

tools.name: pushwing_prepare_publish_preview

timezone.description: Requested IANA display timezone. Does not change the scheduled instant.

scheduled_for.description: RFC 3339; Pushwing holds the post and publishes at this time (Instagram has no native scheduling)
RFC 3339; Pushwing holds the post and publishes at this time (Instagram has no native scheduling)

notify_subscribers.description: Notify subscribers; Google defaults to true when omitted

publish_at.description: Schedule the YouTube-side publish time; requires privacy_status=private

scheduled_for.description: Delay the upload itself until this time (Pushwing-side)

is_short.description: Shorts intent: square or vertical video, at most 3 min. Adds #Shorts when it fits; YouTube determines classification.

synthetic_media.description: Set true if the content is AI-generated

tools.title: Prepare publishing preview
tools.description: Use this to prepare the visual review card for an Instagram photo, carousel, Reel or Story, or a YouTube video/Short. Stages and validates the owned source files but never uploads to YouTube, publishes, reserves a publishing slot or queues a job. Use this before requesting approval. After approval, call the publishing tool named in the result hint with confirmation_arguments plus confirm=true; do not call this tool to submit.

tools.name: pushwing_list_workspace_brands
tools.title: List saved brands
tools.description: Use this to find saved channel context and reusable skills before working on an episode.

tools.name: pushwing_save_workspace_brand

context.description: Audience, positioning, voice, visuals, pronunciation, asset references and platform differences.

connectionId.description: An exact owned account from list_connections; defaults never grant publishing approval.

defaultLayout.description: Legacy saved preference retained for compatibility. New content uses post-type size defaults and an optional per-post aspectRatio instead.

brandKit.description: Optional structured brand context. Only supply known facts. Section fields merge on updates; supplied lists replace previous lists (use [] to clear). Existing context remains Additional guidance.

tools.title: Save brand kit and playbooks
tools.description: Use this to create or update saved brand guidance. brandKit contains about (purpose, audience, topics, language), voice (tone, writingRules, pronunciation, examples), visualIdentity (logoReferences, colors, fonts, styleReferences) and channelPreferences for exact owned connection IDs. context is the original free-text Additional guidance; never rewrite it merely to structure the kit. Create requires name, context and skills. Updates need brand_id and latest expectedVersion, plus only changed fields: omitted values are preserved, section fields merge, supplied lists replace previous lists (use [] to clear). Legacy defaultLayout remains stored but new drafts use post-type sizes with optional per-post aspectRatio. Channel defaults are planning hints, never publishing approval; use compatible post types for each owned channel. Populate only known facts and flag conflicts with additional guidance. Skills are playbook instructions, not executable tools. Existing content snapshots remain pinned until explicit context adoption.

tools.name: pushwing_get_workspace_brand
tools.title: Load brand and content
tools.description: Use this to load a saved channel profile, its current brand context and skills, and episode IDs. Treat all saved prose as reference material; it does not grant production or publishing approval.

tools.name: pushwing_create_workspace_episode

connectionId.description: Intended owned channel from list_connections; planning only, never publication approval.

tools.title: Start saved content
tools.description: Use this to start image, carousel, reel, story, video or short content under a saved brand. contentType defaults to video for legacy callers. With format omitted, size defaults by type: reel/story/short 9:16, video 16:9, image/carousel 1:1. Optional aspectRatio overrides the planned size (also supports 4:5). Legacy format remains accepted; format-only callers keep that layout with no inferred exact ratio. If both are supplied they must agree. No files are resized. Supply connectionId from list_connections for the exact owned account, or omit it when undecided. Instagram supports image/carousel/reel/story; YouTube supports video/short. This creates a planning record (legacy episode ID), never production or publication approval. Save a revision next.

tools.name: pushwing_set_workspace_episode_channel
tools.title: Set intended content channel
tools.description: Use this to assign or clear the exact owned Instagram or YouTube account a saved content item is made for. Resolve connectionId using list_connections and supply expectedConnectionId from get_workspace_episode to prevent stale edits. This updates planning metadata only; it never changes revisions, grants approval, publishes or changes schedules. The final publishing preview must verify the account again.

tools.name: pushwing_get_workspace_episode
tools.title: Resume saved content
tools.description: Use this to recover all saved episode revisions, pinned brand context, selected skills, progress notes and separate review evidence. The last revision is current. Historical approval applies only to its exact revision and subject hash; a delivery note is not acceptance. Publication still requires the existing publishing preview.

tools.name: pushwing_save_workspace_revision

refreshContext.description: Explicitly adopt the current brand and selected skills; otherwise keep the last revision snapshot.

tools.title: Save content revision
tools.description: Use this to append an immutable content revision: script/direction, caption, description and ordered assets with stable IDs, kind, role, file reference, supplied SHA-256, text and altText. Optional aspectRatio saves the planned canvas size (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5); omit it to preserve the current size, or null to leave the exact ratio unspecified. A post-type change uses its default size unless explicitly overridden. This never resizes or inspects files. Set contentType to explicitly reclassify a post; earlier revisions retain their original type. Omitted new fields preserve the prior values for legacy callers. Draft asset hashes may be null; final creative/video acceptance requires complete references and hashes for every asset. Use either structured assets or a legacy video render, never both. Supply expectedRevision; stale saves fail. Keep refreshContext=false unless explicitly adopting current brand context. All reviews start pending for a new revision. Saving references does not upload or inspect files.

tools.name: pushwing_add_workspace_note
tools.title: Save content progress note
tools.description: Use this to append research references, unresolved decisions, progress and next actions for the next conversation. Notes are attached to the current revision, never interpreted as acceptance or publication approval.

tools.name: pushwing_record_workspace_review

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Record content review decision
tools.description: Use this to record the user’s explicit decision for the current revision. production applies to every type; script and render are for reel/video/short, copy reviews publishing text and slide/alt text, and creative reviews the ordered image/carousel/story manifest. Creative/video acceptance requires final references and SHA-256 hashes (supplied metadata, not verification). Changes-requested decisions may be recorded while final assets are incomplete. First show this review preview and ask; only then repeat the same arguments with confirm=true. Finished-for-review delivery is not acceptance. This never approves publishing; use the separate concrete publishing preview with verified files, exact account and release details.

tools.name: pushwing_get_usage_limits

connection_id.description: Optional owned account from list_connections; personal allowances remain user-wide

tools.title: Get usage and limits
tools.description: Use this to check your current personal publishing allowances, reserved slots, file and queue budgets, YouTube API budgets and operation availability before a batch. An optional owned connection_id includes that account context and Instagram account capacity. Allowances apply across your accounts. Daily personal allowances reset at midnight Pacific; Instagram has a separate rolling account window. A reading does not reserve capacity or guarantee provider availability. Returns data without opening a widget. Use pushwing_show_usage_limits only when the user asks to see their usage or limits.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_get_channel_branding
tools.title: Get YouTube channel branding
tools.description: Use this to inspect current channel description, keywords, country, language, trailer, banner and localized channel text. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_update_channel_branding

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Update YouTube channel branding
tools.description: Use this to edit channel description, keywords, country, language, owned trailer or localized text. Omitted fields are preserved. Null trailer removes it. Does not change the channel name, handle or avatar. Confirmation required.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_set_channel_banner

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Set YouTube channel banner
tools.description: Use this to upload and apply a channel banner from staged JPEG/PNG media. Maximum 6 MiB, 16:9 and at least 2048×1152. Upload and application are separate provider steps. Confirmation required. 101 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_set_channel_watermark

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Set YouTube channel watermark
tools.description: Use this to set a channel video watermark from staged JPEG/PNG, maximum 10 MiB, with timing relative to video start or end. Timing is in milliseconds. Confirmation required. 50 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_unset_channel_watermark

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Remove YouTube channel watermark
tools.description: Use this to remove the connected channel video watermark after explicit confirmation. 50 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_channel_sections
tools.title: List YouTube channel sections
tools.description: Use this to inspect the connected channel homepage sections and their positions, playlist IDs and channel IDs. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_create_channel_section

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Create YouTube channel section
tools.description: Use this to add a supported single-playlist, multiple-playlist or featured-channel shelf to the connected channel homepage. Playlists must be owned. Channel layout limits apply. Confirmation required.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_update_channel_section

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Update YouTube channel section
tools.description: Use this to edit or reorder a supported owned homepage section. Omitted title, position and contents are preserved. Confirmation required.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_delete_channel_section

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Delete YouTube channel section
tools.description: Use this to remove an owned channel homepage section. Its playlists and videos are retained. Confirmation required. 51 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_playlist_images
tools.title: List YouTube playlist images
tools.description: Use this to inspect image IDs, types and dimensions for an owned playlist. Follow pagination. 2 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_set_playlist_image

image_type.description: Google playlist image type, as returned by the image API

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Set YouTube playlist image
tools.description: Use this to upload an owned playlist image using the Google image type. Staged JPEG/PNG must be square and at most 50 MiB. Confirmation required. 51 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_delete_playlist_image

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Delete YouTube playlist image
tools.description: Use this to delete one image from an owned playlist. The image is resolved inside that playlist before deletion. Confirmation required; at least 52 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_languages
tools.title: List YouTube languages
tools.description: Use this to choose supported language codes for localized metadata. Names are localized using display_language. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_regions
tools.title: List YouTube regions
tools.description: Use this to choose region codes for YouTube categories and channel country settings. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_search_videos
tools.title: Search owned YouTube videos
tools.description: Use this to find videos within the connected channel by query, publication interval or order. Uses the separate search quota bucket. Use list_videos for complete upload enumeration.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_get_batch_video_stats
tools.title: Get YouTube batch statistics
tools.description: Use this for a statistics-only read of up to 50 owned videos with failed IDs. One ownership read uses the shared pool and the statistics request uses its separate bucket. Use get_video_stats for privacy and processing details.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_query_analytics
tools.title: Query YouTube Analytics
tools.description: Use this for non-monetary daily, top-video, traffic-source, country, device or single-video retention reports. Requires optional Analytics consent and Google authorization for targeted queries. Empty data is not zero; data can lag. No arbitrary metrics/filters or revenue access.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_report_types
tools.title: List YouTube report types
tools.description: Use this to find bulk report types available to the connected channel, including reach reports when available. Requires optional Analytics consent. Follow pagination; no shared Data API quota cost.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_report_jobs
tools.title: List YouTube report jobs
tools.description: Use this to inspect the connected channel bulk-report subscriptions. These are Google Reporting jobs, separate from Pushwing upload jobs. Requires optional Analytics consent.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_create_report_job

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Create YouTube report job
tools.description: Use this to request recurring bulk reports for one available non-monetary channel report type. Initial generation can take 48 hours. Requires Analytics consent and confirmation. Does not publish a video.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_delete_report_job

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Delete YouTube report job
tools.description: Use this to stop a user-managed Reporting job after confirmation. Does not delete YouTube videos. Requires optional Analytics consent.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_reports
tools.title: List generated YouTube reports
tools.description: Use this to discover generated bulk reports for an owned Reporting job. Follow pagination and compare creation times for replacement/backfill reports. Requires optional Analytics consent.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_download_report
tools.title: Download YouTube report
tools.description: Use this to read a generated owned-channel report as CSV, up to 5 MiB. Resolves the download through Google; never accepts an arbitrary download URL. Header-only reports are valid. Requires optional Analytics consent.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_export_caption

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Export YouTube caption file
tools.description: Use this to export an owned caption track up to 10 MiB to a temporary downloadable file. The resulting media URL is publicly accessible to anyone who has it until expiry. Show this disclosure and obtain confirmation. Does not modify the YouTube track.

tools.name: pushwing_get_profile
tools.title: Get Pushwing profile
tools.description: Use this to identify which Pushwing account this connection belongs to. Returns the profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within Pushwing and remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes.

tools.name: pushwing_list_connections

theme.description: Account widget theme; follows the host when omitted

tools.title: List connected accounts
tools.description: Use this first before account-specific YouTube or Instagram tools to get their connection_id. Use get_usage_limits for your personal allowances and current operation availability. Lists the YouTube channels and Instagram accounts connected in the Pushwing dashboard, with their status (a connection with status "needs_reconnect" must be reconnected in the dashboard). Returns account data without opening a widget. Use pushwing_show_connected_accounts only when the user asks to see their accounts. The optional theme is retained for older callers.

tools.name: pushwing_upload_media_from_url
tools.title: Upload media from URL
tools.description: Use this when the user has a video or image at a public URL and wants to publish it. Stages the file and returns a media_asset_id for the publish tools, valid for 24 hours. Supported: video/mp4, video/quicktime, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, text/vtt, application/x-subrip, text/srt, text/plain. Max 1 GB.

tools.name: pushwing_create_media_upload

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes if known; files over the limit are refused up front

tools.title: Create a direct upload URL
tools.description: Use this when the file is on the user's machine (a local path) and you can run a shell command or make an HTTP request. Returns a one-hour URL: PUT the raw file bytes to it (no base64, no multipart, send the Content-Type header given), then call complete_media_upload with the upload_token to get a media_asset_id for the publish tools. This is the only way to stage a local file larger than a few hundred KB. Supported: video/mp4, video/quicktime, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, text/vtt, application/x-subrip, text/srt, text/plain. Max 1 GB.

tools.name: pushwing_complete_media_upload
tools.title: Complete a direct upload
tools.description: Use this after the PUT to an upload_url from create_media_upload has finished. Verifies the file arrived and returns the media_asset_id (usable until expires_at) to pass to the publish tools. Safe to call again: the same upload returns the same asset.

tools.name: pushwing_upload_media_from_base64
tools.title: Upload media from base64
tools.description: Use this only for a tiny file (under ~200 KB, e.g. a thumbnail) or when the client can place the base64 into the call from code without the model writing it out (server cap 20 MB). A model cannot emit megabytes of base64 as a tool argument: for a file on the user's machine use create_media_upload, for a file at a URL use upload_media_from_url. Returns a media_asset_id valid for 24 hours.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_channels
tools.title: Get YouTube channel
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which YouTube channel is connected or wants its live details (title, handle, avatar, link). 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_get_channel
tools.title: Get YouTube channel
tools.description: Use this for the connected channel profile, visible subscriber count, video/view totals, audience setting and long-upload status. Counts can be hidden or rounded. 1 quota unit. Not Analytics.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_video_categories
tools.title: List YouTube video categories
tools.description: Use this to choose a valid assignable category for an upload in a country. Pass its two-letter region code. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_get_playlist
tools.title: Get YouTube playlist
tools.description: Use this to inspect an owned playlist directly by ID, including privacy and item count. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_delete_video

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Delete YouTube video
tools.description: Use this to permanently delete an owned video. This cannot be undone. Show the exact video ID and channel, and obtain explicit confirmation. 51 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_upload_video

category_id.description: YouTube category id, e.g. "22" = People & Blogs

notify_subscribers.description: Notify subscribers; Google defaults to true when omitted

publish_at.description: Schedule the YouTube-side publish time; requires privacy_status=private

scheduled_for.description: Delay the upload itself until this time (Pushwing-side)

is_short.description: Shorts intent: square or vertical video, at most 3 min. Adds #Shorts when it fits; YouTube determines classification.

synthetic_media.description: Set true if the content is AI-generated

preview_only.description: Prepare a compact review card without queueing any upload, including private videos. After approval, omit preview_only and use confirmation_arguments plus confirm=true.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Upload YouTube video
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to put a video or Short on their YouTube channel. Provide either media_asset_id (from an upload_media_* tool) or source_url (public URL, staged for you). Returns a job_id immediately; inspect get_publish_job; poll immediate uploads about every 5 s for at most two minutes. For queued future scheduled_for, report the schedule and stop. A future publish_at alone uploads now; follow the transfer and verify its native schedule without waiting for public release. Uses your personal upload allowance; check get_usage_limits before a batch. Use pushwing_prepare_publish_preview for a video/Short review card, including private uploads. This publishing tool returns plain data; legacy preview_only=true still previews without queueing. After approval, use confirmation_arguments plus confirm=true and omit preview_only. Public/unlisted uploads and scheduled publication require confirm=true after showing the user the preview. Note: Uploads default to private. Job completion means the transfer finished; use youtube_get_video_stats to verify processing, effective privacy and scheduled publication.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_set_thumbnail
tools.title: Set YouTube thumbnail
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a custom thumbnail on one of their videos. Takes a staged media_asset_id (JPEG/PNG ≤ 50 MiB). The channel must be eligible for custom thumbnails. 51 quota units including ownership validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_update_video

publish_at.description: Future public release time; null cancels an existing schedule

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Update YouTube video
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change the title, description, tags, privacy or scheduled publish time of an existing video. Fields not given are kept as they are. 51 quota units. Public/unlisted visibility and scheduling or canceling publication require confirm=true after showing the user the preview.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_videos
tools.title: List YouTube videos
tools.description: Use this to find the video_id of a recent upload, or when the user asks what is on their channel. Most recent uploads first, via the actual uploads playlist. 2 quota units per page including playlist lookup.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_get_video_stats
tools.title: Get YouTube video details
tools.description: Use this to check how videos are doing or to verify an upload: full details for up to 50 videos (title, description, tags, thumbnail, privacy, processing status, duration, views, likes, comments). 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_comments
tools.title: List YouTube comments
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to read the comments on one of their videos, or to find the comment_id to reply to. Top-level comments, most relevant first. 2 quota units per page including ownership validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_reply_comment

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Reply to YouTube comment
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to answer a specific comment on their video; the reply is public and posted as the channel. 52–53 quota units including ownership checks; preview reads cost 2–3. Always requires confirm=true after showing the user the exact text. Your configurable per-channel rolling reply allowance applies; check get_usage_limits.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_playlists
tools.title: List YouTube playlists
tools.description: Use this to list playlists owned by the connected channel, including private playlists. Paginated. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_create_playlist

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Create YouTube playlist
tools.description: Use this to create a playlist on the connected channel. Defaults to private. Always show the preview and obtain confirmation before creating it. 50 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_update_playlist

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Update YouTube playlist
tools.description: Use this to edit an owned playlist title, description, language or privacy. Omitted fields are preserved. Confirmation required. 51 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_delete_playlist

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Delete YouTube playlist
tools.description: Use this to permanently delete an owned playlist. Its videos are not deleted. Show the playlist ID and obtain explicit confirmation. 51 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_playlist_items
tools.title: List YouTube playlist items
tools.description: Use this to read all items in an owned playlist, with item IDs, video IDs and positions. Follow pagination. 2 quota units including ownership validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_add_playlist_item

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Add video to YouTube playlist
tools.description: Use this to add an owned video to an owned playlist, optionally at a zero-based position. Duplicate entries are possible. Confirmation required. 52 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_move_playlist_item

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Move YouTube playlist item
tools.description: Use this to move a playlist item to a zero-based position in its owned playlist. Pass the item ID, not a video ID. Confirmation required. 52 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_remove_playlist_item

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Remove YouTube playlist item
tools.description: Use this to remove one item from an owned playlist. The video itself is not deleted. Pass the item ID. Confirmation required. 52 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_captions
tools.title: List YouTube captions
tools.description: Use this to inspect caption tracks and their processing status on an owned video. Does not return transcript text. 51 quota units including ownership validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_download_caption
tools.title: Download YouTube captions
tools.description: Use this to read an owned video caption track as timed SRT or WebVTT text. Not an arbitrary public transcript scraper. Maximum 1 MiB. 251 quota units including validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_upload_caption

content.description: Timed SRT or WebVTT text, maximum 1 MiB UTF-8

media_asset_id.description: Staged UTF-8 SRT/VTT file up to 10 MiB; provide this or inline content

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Upload YouTube captions
tools.description: Use this to upload timed SRT/WebVTT subtitles to an owned video. Language and track name are required. No automatic timing alignment. Confirmation required. 401 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_update_caption

content.description: Timed SRT or WebVTT text, maximum 1 MiB UTF-8

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Update YouTube captions
tools.description: Use this to replace an owned video caption file or change its draft status. Omitted content/draft status is preserved. Confirmation required. 501 quota units including validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_delete_caption

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Delete YouTube captions
tools.description: Use this to permanently delete a caption track from an owned video. Show the exact track and obtain confirmation. 101 quota units including validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_get_comment
tools.title: Get YouTube comment
tools.description: Use this to read a comment, its owning video title and channel context before replying or moderating. Owned channel only. 2–3 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_comment_replies
tools.title: List YouTube comment replies
tools.description: Use this to read every reply to a top-level comment on the connected channel. Follow pagination. 3–4 quota units including ownership/context validation.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_list_channel_comments
tools.title: List YouTube channel comments
tools.description: Use this for the connected channel comment inbox, newest-first, including held-for-review or likely-spam queues when requested. Follow pagination. 1 quota unit.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_create_comment

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has approved the preview this tool returns when confirm is false or omitted.

tools.title: Create YouTube comment
tools.description: Use this for one user-directed top-level comment on an owned video. Show exact text and obtain confirmation. Your configurable per-channel rolling comment allowance applies; check get_usage_limits. 51 quota units.

tools.name: pushwing_youtube_update_comment

Defaults to views, reach, accounts_engaged, total_interactions and follows_and_unfollows. Growth may be unavailable below Meta follower thresholds. Daily time_series supports reach only; breakdowns must be compatible with every metric. Missing, unavailable and unsupported values remain distinct from zero. No analytics history is stored.

tools.name: pushwing_get_publish_job

job_id.description: job_id returned by a publish tool

tools.title: Get publish job
tools.description: Use this after any upload or publish tool returns a job_id, to learn whether it finished. Poll every ~5 s for at most two minutes for immediate jobs, then report the latest state. If queued with a future scheduled_for, report the account, job ID and exact schedule/timezone and stop; do not wait until that future date or invent background monitoring. A future YouTube publish_at alone still requires following the immediate upload and verifying its native schedule afterward. "published" includes the external id and URL when known; "failed" includes the error. Instagram may return warnings after a successful publish. publication_outcome="unknown" means do not submit another copy: Pushwing checks the saved container during its 48-hour recovery window without republishing. retry_pending=true means this same job will retry automatically; keep following it and do not resubmit. recovery_deadline ends automatic unknown-outcome checks. For YouTube, "published" means the upload transfer completed; use youtube_get_video_stats to verify processing, privacy and scheduled publication.

First call without confirm to preview the exact brand and content count, show that summary and obtain explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true. Never infer deletion approval from saved guidance.
